name: plan-b3-traditional-streets
description: Counterfactual: Plan 3 massing but 30% of land surrendered to roads and parking. Tile is one module of buildable land plus its share of right-of-way.

solids.internal_circulation_derivation: double-loaded 6-ft corridor along both band centerlines, crossing once at the intersection: 6 x 134 x 2 - 36 = 1,572 sf of 10,900 = 14.4%. Vertical circulation is not charged: gens 1-3 are massing studies that never specified how floors are reached (the no-stairs premise rules out stair cores; the ramp galleries arrive in gen 4).
one 6-ft corridor across the 60-ft pavilion: 360 sf of 3,600 = 10%; entered at grade from the moat
as plan-b3-penthouses: terrace-accessed, no internal corridor
